newsitem.title: IRAQ: Iraq appoints new chairman for military industry.
newsitem.headline: Iraq appoints new chairman for military industry.

text.p: Iraq has sworn in a new chairman of the Military Industrialisation Commission, the government newspaper al-Jumhouriya reported on Monday.
Abdultawab Mulahwaish, a minister of industry and minerals during the 1980s, replaces Dhaif Abdulmajeed.
The paper said the chairman was sworn in in front of President Saddam Hussein. It gave no further details.
